question: What Settings localization contract should OpenClaw support for schema/uiHint-derived config labels, section metadata, and the two partial PRs already open for this issue?
rationale: UI chrome can use the existing Control UI t() pipeline, but schema-derived labels cross the config-schema/UI-hint boundary and the open partial PRs need maintainer-owned sequencing.

options.title: Define One Settings I18n Contract
options.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome plus schema labels, then ask contributors or ClawSweeper to rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

options.title: Land Low-Risk Chrome Slices
options.body: Review the toolbar and Quick Settings PRs as narrow slices while leaving schema-derived labels on this issue.

options.title: Defer Schema Labels
options.body: Keep generated schema labels English for now and narrow this issue to fixed, non-schema Settings UI chrome only.

recommendation.title: Define One Settings I18n Contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome plus schema labels, then ask contributors or ClawSweeper to rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.
